summary: Sonnet is the only candidate close to the pages: complete statements, all six solution tables, correct numbers, and four clean figure crops; its defects are minor (a recomposed masthead title and about eight silently corrected printed typos), so the gold is sonnet corrected field by field. GLM's text is good but every one of its three crops swallows body text or table rows (critical) and it drops the two closing sentences of problem 2 including the 6378 km datum, while also inventing typos it attributes to the source; haiku has clipped or truncated crops, treats the observation table as a figure, omits all six solution tables and garbles large parts of both solutions. The GLM checker was substantively right on haiku (with wrong path indices and one misdiagnosed bbox) and right to pass sonnet; the haiku checker of GLM is unreliable — it certified the three defective crops as accurate and found only the grade field.
